correctness.rationale: The proof reduces graph gradient fields to a finite partial-orientation model and exhausts all 15625 possible tail assignments. The packaged verifier checks the complete face set, every Hasse cover relation, acyclicity of the 2724-pair matching, the critical-cell distribution {0:1,4:675}, and independent mod-2 boundary ranks. Forman's standard acyclic-matching theorem then gives the wedge of 675 four-spheres.

value.rationale: The octahedral graph is a canonical 4-regular Platonic graph and the first nontrivial K_6-minus-perfect-matching example. Exact Morse-complex homotopy types are sparse in the literature, while the closest general theorem gives only connectivity. The 675-sphere decomposition is therefore a natural exact benchmark rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
